2.title: isabel.fm
2.work: a pink, chrome music player that connects to whatever i’m listening to on spotify.
2.process: built a retro player, connected it to spotify, and refined the layout and playback buttons. i want it to be a little thing in the corner of my screen instead of a browser tho

3.title: cymatics
3.work: a black and white interface for exploring sound through chladni-inspired patterns. change the frequency, listen to the tone, and save a pattern.
3.process: started with a visual that changed with frequency, then tried moving particles on a simulated plate. the slider and shuffle behaved differently, and the shapes didn’t look right, so i refined the controls and switched to symmetric nodal patterns. it’s a digital representation of chladni patterns, rather than a simulation of a specific physical plate.
3.inspiration: cymatics and chladni plate experiments, where sand collects along the still parts of a vibrating surface.

4.title: pomodoro timer
4.work: i made a cute lil pomodoro timer because i've been having trouble studying and i yearn for coziness
4.process: i chose pics from pinterest and tried to make the simplest UI since it's not supposed to distract me
4.inspiration: pinterest AF. also i use pomodoro youtube videos when i study but i like to listen to my own music, so i just wanted the visual
